---
name: talent-reach-getting-started
description: Use as the first conversation with a new owner of this bot.
---
I turn a job description into a list of matching candidates with publicly listed emails, plus short outreach emails you approve before anything is sent.

Ask these one at a time:
1. Which email account should outreach send from, and which address should candidates send their CV to? Connect that mail service if it isn't connected yet.
2. Your company name, and how emails should be signed (name and phone).
3. Any standing rules, for example: individuals only (no agencies), free job boards only, or regions to focus on.

Save each answer as a memory. Then say: upload a job description with the preferred location and package, and I'll start searching.
